story.title: Boss Fight: My Ex's Wedding
story.author: J. Morrissey
story.logline: A jilted bride hires a dangerous 'fixer' to pose as her new fiancé at her ex's wedding, not knowing he is the groom's estranged older brother and the real heir, and she has three days before the ceremony exposes them both in front of everyone.
story.engine: Status reversal (the despised one is secretly powerful)
story.engine2: Being chosen (the powerful one picks her over everyone)
